## RuvNet Brain: ground rUv claims

For Ruflo, RuVector/RVF, AgentDB, SPARC, agentic-flow, or other rUv-stack capability
claims, search the installed RuvNet Brain first and cite the exact returned source path.
Do not substitute training memory for source evidence or infer reachability from tool
registration. State plainly when the source is unavailable or inconclusive.

Agentic-kit owns this guidance and its managed install/update projection; it disables the
installer's competing CLAUDE.md enhancement, nightly prompt, and telemetry offers. The
